intro: Senegal is mostly flat, with a long Atlantic coast, river valleys and the Gambia nearly splitting it in two.

chapters.title: Coast and rivers
text: The Senegal River forms the northern border and the Casamance region in the south is green and wet. The Gambia, a narrow country, cuts into Senegal from the coast.
Cap-Vert, near Dakar, is the westernmost point of mainland Africa.

chapters.title: Nature
text: Djoudj is a famous bird sanctuary, and Lac Rose is a pink salt lake. Niokolo-Koba park has lions and chimpanzees.

keyTerms.meaning: The dry belt south of the Sahara.
